focus: Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics: v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]). Let the learner change Vmax, Km and the substrate concentration. Show the reaction rate curve and mark the current point and Km. Guide them to see that at [S]=Km the rate is half of Vmax, and that the rate saturates at high [S]. Check v(Km)=Vmax/2 and v approaches Vmax for large [S].
